handback.title: Settings read from shipped defaults, merged and checked
handback.summary: Dokima reads its shipped defaults, merges a repo's settings over them, warns on typos and refuses locked settings.
handback.user_story: A repo writes only what differs, and Dokima merges it over its defaults, warning on typos.

acceptance_criteria.text: A repo with no settings file runs on Dokima's one shipped defaults file.
acceptance_criteria.words: Dokima ships one defaults file that every repo's settings fall back to.

edge_cases.case: An empty settings file still gives the shipped defaults.

acceptance_criteria.text: A repo's settings file changes only the settings it names; every other keeps its default.
acceptance_criteria.words: A repo's settings file changes only the settings it names; every other keeps its default.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Other groups and keys of the same group are checked in one test; no other case is named.

acceptance_criteria.text: The defaults file holds every setting of the owner's list, each with the default the list names.
acceptance_criteria.words: The defaults file holds every setting of the owner's 41-row list, each with the default the list names.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One test checks each setting by name; the list itself holds no other case.

acceptance_criteria.text: A settings group in a repo's file merges with the defaults key by key, the repo winning.
acceptance_criteria.words: A settings group in a repo's file merges with the defaults key by key, the repo winning.

edge_cases.case: A key two levels down, one word cap, keeps every other cap.

acceptance_criteria.text: A list in a repo's file replaces the default list whole.
acceptance_criteria.words: A list in a repo's file replaces the default list whole.

edge_cases.case: An empty list empties the setting.

acceptance_criteria.text: Gates in a repo's file merge with the default gates by name.
acceptance_criteria.words: Gates in a repo's file merge with the default gates by name.

edge_cases.case: A gate named like a default one takes its place.

acceptance_criteria.text: Prompt additions in a repo's file merge with the default ones by name.
acceptance_criteria.words: Prompt additions in a repo's file merge with the default ones by name.

edge_cases.case: An addition named like a default one takes its place.

acceptance_criteria.text: An unknown setting shows a warning that suggests the closest known name.
acceptance_criteria.words: An unknown setting shows a warning that suggests the closest known name.

edge_cases.case: A misspelt group name gets the closest group suggested.

acceptance_criteria.text: An unknown setting is ignored and the run goes on.
acceptance_criteria.words: An unknown setting is ignored and the run goes on.

edge_cases.case: A whole unknown group is ignored too.

acceptance_criteria.text: Setting any of the five locked settings in a repo's file fails the run, naming it.
acceptance_criteria.words: Setting any of the five locked settings in a repo's file fails the run, naming it.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Each of the five is set in turn in one test; no other case is named.

raises.label: Install the YAML reader
raises.text: Test machines lack the YAML library. The plan adds it to four test setups, awaiting your approval.
raises.evidence: `full-suite.yml:27` installs only pytest and pytest-xdist; story [#794](https://github.com/dokima-dev/dokima/issues/794) installs later.

raises.label: List not in reach
raises.text: Your 41-row list was not in my pack. The test checks 32 settings rebuilt from earlier quotes. Enough?
raises.evidence: `owner_words.json` lacks the #740 comment; co-author, merge queue and check name rows were never quoted.

raises.label: Turn limit default
raises.text: Your list says agents get 60 turns; a newer change set 100. The plan assumes 100.
raises.evidence: Commit `f32b5fd` sets 100 in `dokima/agent_claude.py:26`, until the settings file holds it.
